text: {"lessons":["My early sales of winning positions felt rewarding, but I should weigh each stock’s future prospects rather than sell just to lock in a gain.","I held Stock C through a very large decline before selling at a loss. Set clear, thesis-based review points so reluctance to admit a mistake does not keep me in a deteriorating position.","After selling Stock E at a loss, I bought Stock B and Stock D without a clear rationale in this record. Before any trade, check that it fits my plan and current evidence, not just the urge to make up losses or stay active."]}
